name: manage_custom_voice
description: List the current user's cloned voices, preflight creation access, create a Fish Audio voice clone from an uploaded project audio asset, apply one to the current request after its Pro entitlement check, rename or delete it, or regenerate a short preview. Load the voice Skill before use. Clone only after the user has uploaded a supported audio file and explicitly confirmed that the voice is theirs or they have permission to clone it. The backend enforces the free-trial/Pro slot policy and preview text length. Preview returns a URL for a voice audition card. Apply requires Pro but does not generate audio or consume credits. Use submit_voice with provider fish-audio and the returned customVoiceId to generate final audio.

confirmedConsent.description: Required and true for clone. The user explicitly confirmed ownership or permission.

confirmedDelete.description: Required and true for delete, after the user explicitly confirmed permanent deletion.

customVoiceId.description: Required for apply, preview, rename, and delete. Accepts a unique id prefix.

previewText.description: Required for clone/preview. Contextual sample copy limited to 100 Unicode characters.

projectId.description: Existing project ID from the editor URL or list_projects. Pass this when continuing work on an existing project and the external MCP session is not already targeted.

sourceAssetId.description: Required for clone. A project-local ChatCut audio asset ID; an unambiguous ID prefix returned by browse_assets is accepted. Video assets and detached timeline audio are not valid clone sources.
